content: App Review guideline specifics verified: 2.5.1 public-APIs-only and must run on current OS; 2.5.2 no code download/execution and no data outside container; 2.3.1 hidden/undocumented features rejected; 4.2 repackaged website rejection; 5.2.2 third-party service ToS compliance with authorization on request; 5.2.3 forbids streaming that violates third-party ToS (explicitly names YouTube); 1.4 physical harm; CarPlay HIG requires glanceable non-video UI while driving. CarPlay June 2026: video category requires parked playback + AirPlay support; templates mandatory for all CarPlay apps.
